name: The Stranger
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. The default avatar: the player, seen once, in the finale's left-hand chair, and later online. No face (a shadow under the hat), so no face layers; NO tells (rule 3): it acts out only what the player did. Its scarf, hat band and cuffs are the one teal (hue 175-202): the player's accent colour replaces it at load (web/puppet/player.ts).

what.A1: Rest: forearms on the table's edge, gloved hands apart
what.A3: Check: two fingers tap the felt
what.A4: Call: right hand pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right hand pushed well forward
what.A6: Fold: a small push of the hand
what.B1: All in: both hands push forward together
what.B2: Show: right hand turns palm up
what.B4: Crushing loss: hat brim pulled down, head bowed (`lose_big`)
what.B5: Heads up: leaning in on both forearms
what.B6: Talking: a hand raised, palm open
what.C1: LOOP: tips the brim of the hat
what.C2: LOOP: settles the scarf at the collar
what.C4: LOOP: turns the coat collar up
what.C5: LOOP: pulls a glove snug at the wrist

rest.what: the right forearm in its coat sleeve and the gloved hand
the left forearm in its coat sleeve and the gloved hand
